reason: Add synthetic appointment booking, attributed retry-safe rescheduling/cancellation, explicit administrative state transitions and an authorized clinic queue. One doctor has at most one in-progress administrative visit across clinics. Shared UI owns the complete calendar, queue and controlled dialogs; app logic retains exact permissions, patient lookup, CAS/idempotency and scope. Minimal revision-only Realtime invalidations trigger authoritative refresh after join/reconnect. Private state and obsolete requests clear on context, session or grant loss. Appointment history and original clinic/timezone references survive rule/location edits and archive. External notifications and clinical authority remain disabled.
